Good catch. We actually missed the password recovery flow, and it should definitely be part of a production-ready vendor app.

However, it doesn't belong in the Settings module. It belongs in the Authentication flow before login.

Recommended Forgot Password Flow (3 Screens)

1. Forgot Password

  • Enter email address or phone number

  • Send OTP / Reset Link button

⬇️

2. Verify OTP

  • 6-digit verification code

  • Resend code

  • Countdown timer

  • Verify button

⬇️

3. Create New Password

  • New password

  • Confirm password

  • Password strength indicator

  • Success → Redirect to Login

Updated Remaining Screens

Authentication

  • Forgot Password

  • Verify Reset OTP

  • Create New Password

Total: 3 screens

Orders

  • Manage Orders

  • Order Details

  • Accept / Reject

  • Preparing Order

  • Ready for Pickup

  • Rider Pickup Confirmation

  • Order Resolution

  • Order Timeline

Total: 8 screens

Grand Total Remaining

  • 🔐 Authentication: 3 screens

  • 📦 Orders: 8 screens

Total Remaining: 11 screens

I also recommend one more optional screen

For an even more polished experience, add a Password Reset Success screen with a checkmark illustration and a "Back to Login" button.

That would make the authentication flow:

  1. Forgot Password

  2. Verify OTP

  3. Create New Password

  4. Password Reset Success

This success screen isn't strictly necessary—you can redirect to Login after showing a success toast—but many polished apps include it because it gives users clear confirmation that the reset was completed.
